title: Futuristic Duck Pavilion Architect
description: The user designs a futuristic architectural pavilion by placing ion drive engine pylons as structural columns and positioning golden duck statues as decorative sculptures across a plaza grid. Users must configure pylon height, rotation, duck scale, pedestal elevation, lighting color, and finally validate the full composition before exporting the blueprint.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with ES modules from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive futuristic pavilion architecture tool. Load PrimaryIonDrive.glb and Duck.glb using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: a 20x20 ground plane with a subtle grid texture representing a plaza floor, soft ambient light (intensity 0.4), one directional light, and a PerspectiveCamera at position (0,8,14) with OrbitControls. The interaction flow has these steps: (1) PLACE PYLONS: User clicks a 'Place Pylon' button, then clicks on the grid to place up to 4 ion drive models as structural columns at clicked positions. Validate that pylons are placed at least 3 units apart. (2) ADJUST PYLON HEIGHT: A slider (range 1-5, step 0.5) scales each pylon vertically. User selects a pylon by clicking it (highlight with emissive color), then adjusts. Validate height is within range. (3) PLACE DUCKS: User clicks 'Place Duck' then clicks the grid to place up to 3 duck statues. Validate ducks are placed at least 2 units from any pylon. (4) DUCK PEDESTAL HEIGHT: A slider (0.5-3, step 0.25) sets the Y position of a selected duck, simulating a pedestal. Validate range. (5) ROTATE DUCKS: A rotation slider (0-360 degrees) rotates the selected duck around Y axis. (6) ACCENT LIGHTING: User picks a color from an HTML color input to set a PointLight (intensity 2, positioned at center, height 6) that bathes the pavilion in accent color. (7) VALIDATE & EXPORT: A 'Validate Blueprint' button checks all constraints — at least 2 pylons placed, at least 1 duck, all distances valid, all parameters in range — then displays a green success banner or red error list. Use a left-side HTML panel for controls with clean dark-themed styling. Show step instructions at the top. Raycasting handles object selection and grid placement. Selected objects get an orange emissive highlight.
